# q_base = [0, 0, 0.4994414, 0.8663477]

# q_delta = q_base * q_7^-1
# Since both are pure z-rotations:
# q_7^-1 = [0, 0, 0.5432470, 0.8395729]
# z_delta = z1*w2 + w1*z2 = 0.4994414 * 0.8395729 + 0.8663477 * 0.5432470
# w_delta = w1*w2 - z1*z2 = 0.8663477 * 0.8395729 - 0.4994414 * 0.5432470

z1, w1 = 0.4994414150714874, 0.8663476705551147
z2, w2 = 0.5432470088501988, 0.8395729195100428  # conjugate of q_7
